# Plant heirloom tomatoes

## Status

- **Phase:** Draft
- **Type:** feature
- **Sprint:** spring-planting
- **Story:** raised-beds

## Approach

Start the seedlings indoors, then transplant into the [raised beds](../stories/raised-beds/STORY-raised-beds.md)
once the last frost has passed. This section exists to give the plan viewer some
**rich markdown** to render.

Varieties to sow this year:

- Brandywine
- Cherokee Purple
- San Marzano

Water with `drip-irrigation` on a timer, roughly:

```
0600  20 minutes
1800  20 minutes
```

## Branches

A plan PR the board can NAME, so the armed Approve label can say what the
second click will do. `pumpkin-patch` deliberately has no such section — the
two together are the pair the Approve button's label logic turns on.

- `feature/sow-seedlings` → #146
